title: The Cosmos
description: Public-domain views of deep space from Hubble and the James Webb Space Telescope.

items.title: An Audience Favorite Nebula
items.description_narrative: This captivating photograph, titled 'An Audience Favorite Nebula,' was captured by NASA – JPL, offering a detailed view of a celestial body. As a product of advanced spaceflight and astronomy, it exemplifies our exploration and understanding of the cosmos.
items.tags: nebula, astronomy, space, photograph, celestial, cosmic

items.title: James Webb Space Telescope Southern Ring Nebula (NIRCam and MIRI Images Side by Side)
items.description_narrative: This dual image from the James Webb Space Telescope reveals the Southern Ring Nebula with unprecedented detail, captured by both its Near-Infrared Camera (NIRCam) and Mid-Infrared Instrument (MIRI). These views allow scientists to study the nebula's expanding gas and dust shells, providing new insights into the dying stages of a star.
items.tags: nebula, astronomy, space, photograph, science, cosmic, infrared, 2022

items.title: Pillars of Creation
items.agent_name: SCIENCE: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; IMAGE PROCESSING: Joseph DePasquale (STScI), Anton M. Koekemoer (STScI), Alyssa Pagan (STScI)
items.description_narrative: This iconic astronomical image captures towering structures of interstellar gas and dust within the Eagle Nebula, where new stars are actively forming. These "pillars" are dense nurseries sculpted by the intense radiation and stellar winds from massive, hot, young stars.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, star formation, cosmic, space, scientific, majestic

items.title: Webb's First Deep Field
items.description_narrative: This groundbreaking image, captured by the James Webb Space Telescope, unveils thousands of galaxies in a breathtaking deep-field view of the early universe. It reveals unprecedented details through infrared light, including the faintest objects ever observed and distorted galaxy shapes due to gravitational lensing.
items.tags: space, galaxies, astronomy, universe, deep field, infrared, scientific, cosmic

items.title: Cosmic Cliffs Carina Nebula
items.description_narrative: This stunning image captures the dramatic 'Cosmic Cliffs' within the Carina Nebula, a colossal stellar nursery located about 7,600 light-years away. It reveals intricate structures of gas and dust where new stars are actively forming.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, space, cosmic, carina, star formation, scientific image

items.title: Hubble Ultra Deep Field
items.agent_name: NASA and the European Space Agency.
items.description_narrative: This extraordinary image, a mosaic of observations from the Hubble Space Telescope, reveals an estimated 10,000 galaxies across a tiny patch of sky. It offers a profound glimpse into the early universe, showcasing celestial structures billions of light-years away.
items.tags: space, astronomy, galaxies, universe, scientific observation, cosmology, deep field

items.title: Sombrero Galaxy
items.agent_name: NASA/ESA and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
items.description_narrative: The Sombrero Galaxy (M104) is a spiral galaxy known for its bright nucleus, large central bulge, and a prominent dust lane that appears as a dark band silhouetted against the bulge. This dramatic image captures the galaxy's distinctive hat-like appearance, a visual spectacle of stars, gas, and dust.
items.tags: galaxy, spiral galaxy, astronomy, space, scientific imaging, deep space, cosmic

items.description_narrative: This iconic image captures the Whirlpool Galaxy (M51), a magnificent spiral galaxy interacting with its smaller companion galaxy. Its striking arms are areas of active star formation, revealed in intricate detail by the Hubble Space Telescope.
items.tags: galaxy, astronomy, space, spiral galaxy, star formation, cosmic, scientific image

items.title: Crab Nebula
items.description_narrative: The Crab Nebula is the luminous remnant of a supernova observed by Chinese astronomers in 1054 CE. This dynamic celestial object, located about 6,500 light-years from Earth, contains a rapidly spinning pulsar at its core.
items.tags: astronomy, space, nebula, supernova remnant, scientific imagery, cosmic, celestial, data visualization

items.title: Horsehead Nebula
items.description_narrative: This striking image captures the iconic Horsehead Nebula, a dark nebula forming part of the larger Orion Molecular Cloud Complex. Its distinctive shape, reminiscent of a seahorse's head, is formed by a dense cloud of gas and dust silhouetted against a brighter emission nebula.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, cosmos, space, astrophotography, celestial, deep space

items.title: Andromeda Galaxy
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, Benjamin F. Williams (UWashington), Zhuo Chen (UWashington), L. Clifton Johnson (Northwestern); Image Processing: Joseph DePasquale (STScI).[1]
items.description_narrative: This stunning image captures the vast spiral arms of the Andromeda Galaxy, our closest large galactic neighbor. The intricate details visible reveal countless stars and dust lanes, offering a profound glimpse into the cosmos.
items.tags: galaxy, astronomy, space, cosmos, spiral galaxy, celestial, scientific image, universe
